proposal.residence_time_basis: Liquid phase residence time through packed bed
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Simultaneous mixing of equimolar reactants ensures immediate contact with the heterogeneous catalyst upon entering the packed bed, maximizing surface reaction efficiency.
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare Stream A: Dissolve benzaldehyde in acetonitrile to 1.0 M.
Prepare Stream B: Dissolve malononitrile in acetonitrile to 1.0 M.
Pack PBR: Load N-doped carbon catalyst into PTFE tubing (ID 1.57 mm, Length ~3.8 m to achieve ~7.5 mL void volume).
Pre-wet catalyst: Flush with acetonitrile at low flow to remove air bubbles.
post_reactor_steps: Quench: Not required (reaction is clean condensation).
Separation: Filter effluent through a 0.22 µm PTFE syringe filter to remove any potential catalyst fines.
Workup: Evaporate acetonitrile under reduced pressure.
Purification: Recrystallize from ethanol if high purity is required.
proposal.chemistry_notes: The batch reaction required 24 h at 50°C. In flow, the heterogeneous catalyst allows for higher temperature operation (80°C) to increase kinetics, while the packed bed ensures high surface-area-to-volume contact. The residence time is significantly reduced from 24 h to 15 min due to improved mass transfer and thermal efficiency. Acetonitrile is used as it dissolves both reactants and is compatible with PTFE.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Reduced from 24h batch to 15min based on typical Knoevenagel condensation kinetics in flow with heterogeneous catalysts. Higher T (80C vs 50C) compensates for shorter time.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.5 mL/min total flow chosen to maintain laminar flow in narrow ID tubing and ensure good heat transfer.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Increased to 80°C to accelerate reaction rate, well below acetonitrile boiling point (81.6°C) at 20 bar pressure.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 1.0 M in each stream results in 0.5 M final concentration, balancing solubility and reaction rate.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 20 bar ensures acetonitrile remains liquid at 80°C and prevents cavitation.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Packed Bed is essential for heterogeneous N-doped carbon catalyst.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PTFE is chemically resistant to acetonitrile and organics.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.57 mm (1/16 inch) is standard for packed beds, balancing pressure drop and packing ease.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated as Flow Rate (0.5 mL/min) * Residence Time (15 min) = 7.5 mL. This assumes void volume ~40-50% of total packed volume, so physical tube length will be longer.
reasoning_per_field.streams: Two equal streams of 1.0 M reactants mix to form 0.5 M reaction mixture.
reasoning_per_field.mixer_type: Static mixer ensures homogeneity before entering the packed bed.
reasoning_per_field.safety_flags: Malononitrile is toxic and volatile. Ensure closed system. Acetonitrile is flammable. N-doped carbon may be pyrophoric if dry; keep wet.

proposal.literature_analogies: Knoevenagel condensations in flow using heterogeneous catalysts (e.g., basic resins, metal oxides, or doped carbons) typically show residence times in the range of 5-30 minutes at elevated temperatures (60-100°C).
safety_flags: Malononitrile: Toxic, handle in fume hood.
Pressure: 20 bar requires rated fittings and tubing.
